newsitem.title: USA: Sinter to buy Maag pressed powder units.
newsitem.headline: Sinter to buy Maag pressed powder units.

text.p: CLEVELAND, Oct 7 (Reuter) Sinter Metals Inc said Monday it has definitively agreed to buy all of the outstanding shares of Powder Metal Holding Inc, the U.S.'s second-largest producer of precision pressed powder metal components, from Maag Holding AG of Zurich, Switzerland.
Sinter said it would also buy from Maag substantially all of the shares of Krebsoge Sinterholding GmbH, Germany's and Europe's largest precision pressed powder metal components producer.
Sinter said the combined transaction would make it the largest producer of pressed powder metal components in the world with 1997 sales of more than $400 million expected.
The company said the combined purchase price would be about $215 million.
Sinter said the acquisitions would be accretive to shareholders and are expected to close by year-end, subject to certain conditions and U.S. and German governmental approvals.
